create_Olmo2ForCausalLM_model: create an OLMo2 causal language model with HuggingFace config and optional quantization config
run_Olmo2ForCausalLM_forward: run inference on the OLMo2 model given input ids, positions, and forward batch info
build_Olmo2DecoderLayer: build an OLMo2 transformer decoder layer with attention, MLP, and layer normalization blocks
build_Olmo2Attention: build an OLMo2 attention block with QKV projection, RMSNorm, rotary embeddings, and RadixAttention
load_Olmo2ForCausalLM_weights: load HuggingFace-compatible weights into the OLMo2 model with tensor parallel shard mapping
